<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the unknown molecule. The only way to infer this without a given structure is to examine its 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals in the aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm). By counting how many distinct carbon signals appear in that region, we can determine the number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
